title: Adapting Psycholinguistic Research for LLMs: Gender-inclusive Language in a Coreference Context

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the log probability of gendered versus gender-neutral coreferent terms (e.g., men, women, people; he, she, they) following gendered or gender-inclusive antecedent phrases, and manually annotating the gender of entities generated by LLMs in open-ended sentence continuations.
